mappings.note: Why the mother never asked her husband for anything -- a stated fact about a character in the prose text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: nothing is asked about the writer's intent or style.
Who the quoted passage is about; plain comprehension. Rejected C-H1.1: the gadyansh is lifted from the prescribed lesson itself, so it is pathit, not apathit material.
Meaning of 'pados culture' as the passage itself defines it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the answer restates a concept the text explains, it does not appraise the writer's style.
What damaged pados culture -- stated in the passage. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: a content fact, not the lekhika's mantavya.
Which milieu her story characters come from; the passage says so. Rejected C-H1.3 at competency level: this is lesson content, not bibliography about her works.
What she realised while writing stories -- content recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it asks what she realised, not why she wrote.
Consequence of flat culture, stated in the passage. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: no craft or intent judgement is required.

'bhagnavasheshon ko dhona' is the lekhika's own metaphor, and the item asks its tatparya -- reading her figurative style. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: it is not a narrated event nor a dictionary gloss of a single word.
Why the father came to Ajmer -- a life event in the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: factual, not evaluative.
What the father did after reaching Ajmer (the dictionary). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: content recall only.
Why the mother lived in fear -- the cause the text gives. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it asks the stated cause, not a reaction to her silence.
Stated causes of the father's anger. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: recall of the text's own explanation, not an appraisal of his authoritarianism.
The mother's traits as the passage lists them. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: no judgement on the writer's treatment is asked.
What the mother accepted without protest -- listed in the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: recall, not evaluation.
Why she sat at a neighbour friend's house -- a narrated incident. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: no craft question.
Which disposition of hers the passage shows; the answer follows from the narrated events. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it is inference from content, not appreciation of bhasha-shaili.
Asks which upama the writer gave her mother (the earth) -- a figure of speech, i.e. bhasha-shaili. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: the point is the device, not a biographical fact about the mother.
Whose side the children were on -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: recall only.

Why the mother's sacrifice could not become her ideal -- the writer's own verdict on the mother's self-effacement, which the policy puts at LO-2. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: no event in the text answers it.
The mother described as illiterate and patient -- direct recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
The mother met every demand as a duty -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: no reaction to her silence is solicited.
Asks the lekhika's uddeshya in writing about her father's personality -- squarely her mantavya. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: purpose is not vishayvastu.
How she took part in the freedom movement -- narrated actions. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: factual life events.
The father's other spheres of work besides politics -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
The father's personality as the text describes it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: description recall, not an evaluative reaction.

Where the writer was married -- a lekhak-parichay biographical fact, not part of the prose text. The frame carries no biography learning outcome, so C-H1.3 at competency level is the honest citation; C-H1.3-LO-1 was rejected because the fact is not the lesson's vishayvastu.
With whom she clashed most at home (the father) -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the reason for the clash is asked elsewhere; here only the person.
Her age at her elder sister's wedding -- a text fact. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
The complexion she ascribes to herself -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: recall, not appraisal of how she writes about it.
When the father began to notice her -- a narrated turning point. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.

Year and place of Mannu Bhandari's birth -- author biography. The frame has no biography LO, which is why the competency is the honest citation and C-H1.3-LO-1 was rejected: a birth date is not the prescribed text's vishayvastu.
Who shaped and marred her personality (the father) -- the text says so. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it asks who, not how she judges him.
The mother's personality -- description recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
What the father felt on seeing her command respect -- a narrated reaction. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the father's feeling, not the writer's craft.

Which work is NOT by Mannu Bhandari -- bibliography. The frame has no bibliography LO, so the competency is the honest citation; C-H1.3-LO-1 was rejected because a list of her titles is not this lesson's content.
The distinguishing trait of her story characters, stated in the passage. Rejected C-H1.3 at competency level: the text supplies the answer, so it is comprehension and not bibliography.
Consequence of flat culture -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: content, not intent.
Which statement about traditional pados culture is true -- comprehension. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
Which lesson the passage is taken from -- knowledge of the prescribed gadya path itself. Rejected C-H1.3 at competency level: identifying the text is not author biography or literary history.
What the marriage-eligibility rule proves about the family -- inference from a stated custom. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the text supplies the mindset, no stylistic judgement is needed.
What changed after the elder siblings left -- narrated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
The father's view on her learning cookery -- stated in the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it asks his belief, not a reaction to his authoritarianism.
Who 'in logon' refers to in the quoted line -- pronoun reference resolved from context. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: reference resolution is comprehension, not appreciation of the chhatr-chhaya image.
Vakya-bhed: the sentence is mishra. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: the sentence is only the carrier, what is tested is grammatical structure, not the lesson's content.
The consequence of her inferiority complex -- stated in the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2.
Reason for her diffidence even amid praise -- the text gives it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the cause is narrated, not inferred from style.
Paryayvachi of 'upalabdhi'. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: a synonym drill is a vyakaran item under the book's policy, not comprehension of the prose.
Why the father's personality lacked a positive side -- the text's own reasons. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: recall of stated causes.
